question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mercury Planet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mercury** is the smallest planet in our solar system and is closest to the Sun.
 
• Its **orbital period around the Sun** is about 88 Earth days, making it the fastest planet.
 
• Because of its proximity to the Sun, Mercury experiences extreme temperature variations.
 
• It has **no natural satellites** or moons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saturn**

 
 
• Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun and is known for its prominent ring system.
 
• It has a total of 146 moons, with Titan being the largest.
 
• Saturn is a gas giant composed primarily of hydrogen and helium.
 
 
 
• **Uranus**
 
 
• Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun and has a unique blue-green color due to methane in its atmosphere.
 
• It has a tilted axis, causing extreme seasonal variations.
 
• Uranus has 27 known moons, with Titania being the largest.
 
 
 
• **Jupiter**
 
 
• Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system and the fifth from the Sun.
 
• It has a strong magnetic field and at least 79 moons, with Ganymede being the largest.
 
• Jupiter is known for its Great Red Spot, a giant storm that has been raging for centuries.
